raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation `SGLDOptions` was a flat list of ServerArgs fields. Several did nothing in ComfyUI integrated mode (`dp_size` > 1 is rejected, `enable_cfg_parallel` only recomputes since ComfyUI already splits cond/uncond, `sp_degree` duplicated Ulysses x Ring), FastH3 / VDN-H3 needed `runtime_model_path` plus a base H3 file as a placeholder, and some settings were silently ignored (online `quantization` on ComfyUI files). Breakable CUDA graph did not start at all in ComfyUI mode, and Spectrum never skipped a step. ## Modifications 1. **Runtime fixes (H3 / ComfyUI mode)** - BCG: ServerArgs forced `warmup_mode=server` plus a default warmup resolution, overriding `comfyui_mode`'s `warmup_mode=off`; the synthetic request has no sampler tensors, so every `cuda_graph` worker failed at startup. Skip both in `comfyui_mode` (the H3 step stage captures on its first real step). - Spectrum: each ComfyUI step is a one-step request, so its counters reset every step. The H3 step stage now gives it the run's step count. 2. **`SGLDOptions`** (same node id, new inputs; saved workflows need the node re-set). `model_type` and `num_gpus` stay on top; the rest fold into groups whose headers show the current value (`Parallel · auto`, `Cache · Cache-DiT`): | Group | Fields | |---|---| | Parallel | `parallel_mode` auto / manual; manual: `tp_size`, `ulysses_degree`, `ring_degree` | | Attention | `attention_backend`: auto, flash_attention, torch_sdpa, sage_attention2, sage_attention3, sol_attention, H3 sparse backends; `attention_backend_config` (picking sol_attention fills its defaults) | | Quantization | `quantization` (online, native directories only); `int8_gemm` auto / sglang_jit / comfy_kitchen (GEMM kernel for INT8 ConvRot weights) | | Cache | `cache_mode` off / cache_dit / teacache / spectrum; for cache_dit, `cache_dit_tuning` auto / manual (warmup steps, residual threshold, max consecutive cached steps, Fn blocks). Per request, never restarts the worker | | Execution | `execution_mode` eager / torch_compile / cuda_graph; `regional_compile` | | Memory | `memory_mode` resident / layerwise_offload; resident and prefetch layers | Removed: `sp_degree`, `dp_size`, `dp_degree`, `enable_cfg_parallel`, `runtime_model_path`, `transformer_weights_path` (which weights to load belongs to the loader; `SGLDUNETLoader` already lists local GGUF files). 3. **`SGLDNativeModelLoader`**: loads FastH3 / VDN-H3 native directories (type from `model_index.json`); the ComfyUI model skeleton is built from `transformer/config.json`, so no companion file is needed. 4. **`core/preflight.py`**: checks the options against the resolved model at the loader, before the running worker is touched, and raises instead of ignoring a setting: - cuda_graph: MiniMax H3 only, with cache off and no layerwise offload. - FastH3 / VDN-H3: eager only, ring 1; VDN attention fixed; H3 ring > 1 needs flash_attention; per-model attention allowlist. - cache_dit / spectrum: MiniMax H3 family (spectrum at SP 1). Other models send each sampler step as its own request and need per-run state first (#43696 adds it for Cache-DiT; the allowlist widens when it lands). TeaCache: no integrated model yet. - Online quantization only for native directories; `int8_gemm` only for H3. 5. README and bundled workflows updated. ## Accuracy / Benchmark (2x H200, warm, end-to-end seconds) MiniMax-H3 INT8 ConvRot, 864x480, 107 frames, 20 steps: | config | s | PSNR vs flash_attention | |---|---|---| | flash_attention | 23.5 | ~40 dB (same-seed rerun) | | sage_attention2 / torch_compile / layerwise offload | 23.5 / 23.9 / 23.1 | offload ~40 dB | | cuda_graph (failed at startup before) | 23.0 | ~40 dB | | cache_dit (auto) / cache_dit (manual, threshold 0.3) | 12.7 / 12.3 | 18.9 dB (auto) | | spectrum (11 of 20 steps skipped) | 23.2 | no net speedup; same in native `DiffGenerator` (20.19 vs 20.24 s) | | Ulysses 2 (2 GPUs) | 15.1 | | | FastH3 VSA / VDN-H3 via native loader | 13.5 / 16.2 | | Rejected at the loader (1-6 s, before the worker starts): cuda_graph + cache, compile on FastH3, cache_dit on Z-Image, online quantization on a ComfyUI file. ## SGLDOptions Node Original load node: Choose the options ## Checklist - [x] `pytest test/unit/test_comfyui_*.py test/unit/*cache_dit*.py` (203 passed) - [x] `node --test web/options_state.test.mjs` - [x] pre-commit - [ ] sol_attention on GPU (needs the `sol-attn` package; not installed on the test host yet) --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :white_check_mark: [Run #38569537436](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38569537436) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #38569537076](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38569537076) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #38569537508](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38569537508)

@@ -24,7 +24,7 @@ The plugin supports two modes of operation: **Server Mode** (via HTTP API) and *
 - **Z-Image**: High-speed image generation models (e.g., `Z-Image-Turbo`)
 - **FLUX**: State-of-the-art text-to-image models (e.g., `FLUX.1-dev`)
 - **Qwen-Image**: Multi-modal image generation models (e.g., `Qwen-Image`,`Qwen-Image-2512`). *Note: Image editing support is currently experimental and may have some issues.*
-- **Qwen-Image-2.1**: Integrated mode (`model_type=qwen_image21`, auto-detected) for Comfy-Org's `qwen_image_2.1_bf16.safetensors` or INT8 `qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot.safetensors`. Text-to-image and reference-image edit work with the official templates after swapping `UNETLoader` for `SGLDUNETLoader`. The worker manages the prefix K/V cache itself, so the `Qwen Image 2.1 Cache` node's options are ignored. Multi-GPU: `sp_degree` or `tp_size` (`enable_cfg_parallel` is rejected; ComfyUI runs CFG). DiT patches (Fun-Control, attention hooks) are not supported. LoRA: use `SGLDiffusion LoRA Loader` instead of `LoraLoaderModelOnly`. Tested with `Viggle/Qwen-Image-2.1-viggle-turbo` (`...-v0.3-6step-lora-r128.safetensors`): euler, `BasicGuider`, `ManualSigmas` `1.0, 0.967754, 0.933358, 0.857192, 0.666756, 0.400096, 0` at 1024x1024.
+- **Qwen-Image-2.1**: Integrated mode (`model_type=qwen_image21`, auto-detected) for Comfy-Org's `qwen_image_2.1_bf16.safetensors` or INT8 `qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot.safetensors`. Text-to-image and reference-image edit work with the official templates after swapping `UNETLoader` for `SGLDUNETLoader`. The worker manages the prefix K/V cache itself, so the `Qwen Image 2.1 Cache` node's options are ignored. Multi-GPU: Ulysses / Ring or TP through the manual layout in `SGLDiffusion Options`. DiT patches (Fun-Control, attention hooks) are not supported. LoRA: use `SGLDiffusion LoRA Loader` instead of `LoraLoaderModelOnly`. Tested with `Viggle/Qwen-Image-2.1-viggle-turbo` (`...-v0.3-6step-lora-r128.safetensors`): euler, `BasicGuider`, `ManualSigmas` `1.0, 0.967754, 0.933358, 0.857192, 0.666756, 0.400096, 0` at 1024x1024.
 - **MiniMax-H3**: Joint video-and-audio DiT (`model_type=minimax_h3`). Integrated mode: T2V / I2VA / FL2VA use an `fl2va` checkpoint; R2V needs `ref2va`. CLIP and VAE stay in ComfyUI. Server mode uses `SGLDiffusion Generate MiniMax-H3`.
 
 ### Mode 1: Server Mode (HTTP API)
@@ -43,11 +43,45 @@ ComfyUI keeps CLIP, VAE, and the sampler loop. SGLang loads only the DiT and
 runs one forward per sampler step (pass-through scheduler, no text encode /
 decode on the worker).
 
-1. **Load Model**: Use the `SGLDiffusion UNET Loader` node to load your diffusion model.
-2. **Configure Options**: Use the `SGLDiffusion Options` node to set runtime parameters like `num_gpus`, `tp_size`, `model_type`, or `enable_torch_compile`.
+1. **Load Model**: `SGLDiffusion UNET Loader` loads ComfyUI single files (Qwen-Image, FLUX, Z-Image, MiniMax H3, including pre-quantized `*_int8_convrot` files). It takes the same file as the stock UNET loader, so a workflow switches by replacing that node. `SGLDiffusion Native Model Loader` loads native SGLang model directories that have no ComfyUI file: FastH3 8-Step V2 and VDN-H3 (the model type is read from `model_index.json`).
+2. **Configure Options** (optional): connect `SGLDiffusion Options` to the loader. Without it the worker uses auto-detection and defaults.
 3. **Sample**: Connect the loaded model to standard ComfyUI samplers. Each step is packed by a model adapter and sent to the SGLang scheduler.
 4. **LoRA Support**: Use the `SGLDiffusion LoRA Loader` for native LoRA integration.
 
+### Options
+
+`SGLDiffusion Options` keeps `model_type` and `num_gpus` on
+top; the other groups fold, and each folded header shows its current choice.
+The fields are plain ComfyUI widgets, so the node works without the JavaScript
+extension, which only changes the presentation.
+
+| Group | Fields |
+| --- | --- |
+| Parallel | `parallel_mode` auto or manual; manual sets `tp_size`, `ulysses_degree`, `ring_degree`, whose product must equal `num_gpus` |
+| Attention | `attention_backend`: auto (model default), flash_attention, torch_sdpa, sage_attention2, sage_attention3, sol_attention (H3; needs the `sol-attn` package; picking it fills `attention_backend_config` with its defaults), and the H3 sparse backends; `attention_backend_config` |
+| Quantization | `quantization` (online, native directories only); `int8_gemm`: GEMM implementation for INT8 ConvRot weights, auto / sglang_jit / comfy_kitchen |
+| Cache | `cache_mode`: off, cache_dit, teacache, spectrum (lossy). For cache_dit, `cache_dit_tuning` auto keeps the defaults; manual sets warmup steps, residual threshold, max consecutive cached steps and Fn compute blocks |
+| Execution | `execution_mode`: eager, torch_compile, cuda_graph (breakable CUDA graph); `regional_compile` |
+| Memory | `memory_mode`: resident or DiT layerwise offload; `resident_layers`, `prefetch_layers` |
+
+The loader checks the options against the resolved model before starting the
+worker and raises instead of dropping a setting. Current limits in integrated mode:
+
+| Option | Supported for |
+| --- | --- |
+| cuda_graph | MiniMax H3, with `cache_mode` off and no layerwise offload |
+| torch_compile | all but FastH3 and VDN-H3 |
+| ring_degree > 1 | not FastH3 / VDN-H3; MiniMax H3 needs `fa` |
+| quantization | native model directories; ComfyUI files carry their own format |
+| cache_dit, spectrum | MiniMax H3 family (spectrum: sequence-parallel degree 1); other models send each sampler step as its own request, so a step cache needs per-run state first |
+| teacache | none yet |
+
+Changing anything but the Cache group restarts the worker on the next run.
+
+For development, run `node --test web/options_state.test.mjs` in this plugin
+folder and `python -m pytest python/sglang/multimodal_gen/test/unit/test_comfyui_options.py`
+from the SGLang repository root.
+
 ## Adding a Model
 
 Pick the mode before writing code; the wrong one costs several hundred lines

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""SGLDOptions: runtime options for the SGLD worker.
+
+The output is a flat dict of ServerArgs kwargs plus the plugin-only keys in
+PLUGIN_KEYS, which core/generator.py pops before building ServerArgs. Checks that
+need the resolved model live in core/preflight.py.
+"""
+
+PLUGIN_KEYS = ("model_type", "cache_mode", "cache_dit_params", "int8_kernel")
+
+# Display names -> SGLang backend names; the rest are passed through unchanged.
+_ATTENTION_IDS = {
+    "flash_attention": "fa",
+    "sage_attention2": "sage_attn",
+    "sage_attention3": "sage_attn_3",
+    "sol_attention": "sol_attn",
+}
+# Display names -> SGLANG_DIFFUSION_CONVROT_INT8_BACKEND values.
+_INT8_GEMMS = {"auto": "auto", "sglang_jit": "jit", "comfy_kitchen": "comfy_kitchen"}
+
+
+def _field(group, kind, default, tooltip="", **kwargs):
+    spec = {"default": default, "sgld_group": group, "tooltip": tooltip, **kwargs}
+    return (kind, spec)
+
+
+# Order is the widget order; web/options.js puts a folding header before each group.
+_FIELDS = {
+    "model_type": _field(
+        "basic",
+        ["auto-detect", "qwen_image", "qwen_image_edit", "qwen_image21"]
+        + ["flux", "lumina2", "minimax_h3"],
+        "auto-detect",
+        "FastH3 / VDN-H3 load through the Native Model Loader.",
+    ),
+    "num_gpus": _field("basic", "INT", 1, min=1, max=64),
+    "parallel_mode": _field(
+        "parallel", ["auto", "manual"], "auto", "manual sets TP x Ulysses x Ring."
+    ),
+    "tp_size": _field("parallel", "INT", 1, min=1),
+    "ulysses_degree": _field("parallel", "INT", 1, min=1),
+    "ring_degree": _field("parallel", "INT", 1, min=1),
+    "attention_backend": _field(
+        "attention",
+        ["auto", "flash_attention", "torch_sdpa", "sage_attention2"]
+        + ["sage_attention3", "sol_attention", "subblock_sparse_attn"]
+        + ["video_sparse_attn_h3", "hybrid_window_attn_h3"],
+        "auto",
+        "auto uses the model default; an unavailable backend is rejected.",
+    ),
+    "attention_backend_config": _field(
+        "attention", "STRING", "", "Same format as --attention-backend-config."
+    ),
+    "quantization": _field(
+        "quantization",
+        ["none", "fp8", "convrot_int8", "mxfp8"],
+        "none",
+        "Online quantization; native model directories only.",
+    ),
+    "int8_gemm": _field(
+        "quantization",
+        list(_INT8_GEMMS),
+        "auto",
+        "GEMM kernel for INT8 ConvRot weights; auto prefers sglang_jit.",
+    ),
+    "cache_mode": _field(
+        "cache",
+        ["off", "cache_dit", "teacache", "spectrum"],
+        "off",
+        "Lossy step caching; changing it keeps the worker.",
+    ),
+    "cache_dit_tuning": _field(
+        "cache", ["auto", "manual"], "auto", "manual sets the values below."
+    ),
+    "cache_warmup_steps": _field("cache", "INT", 4, "Full steps first.", min=0),
+    "cache_threshold": _field(
+        "cache", "FLOAT", 0.24, "Higher caches more steps.", min=0.0, step=0.01
+    ),
+    "cache_max_cached_steps": _field("cache", "INT", 3, "Most in a row.", min=0),
+    "cache_fn_blocks": _field("cache", "INT", 1, "Leading blocks computed.", min=0),
+    "execution_mode": _field(
+        "execution", ["eager", "torch_compile", "cuda_graph"], "eager"
+    ),
+    "regional_compile": _field("execution", "BOOLEAN", False, "torch_compile only."),
+    "memory_mode": _field(
+        "memory",
+        ["resident", "layerwise_offload"],
+        "resident",
+        "DiT only; ComfyUI owns the text encoder and VAE.",
+    ),
+    "resident_layers": _field("memory", "INT", 0, "Kept on GPU.", min=0),
+    "prefetch_layers": _field("memory", "INT", 0, "Prefetched; 0 means 1.", min=0),
+}
+
+
+class SGLDOptions:
+    """Grouped runtime options; web/options.js folds the groups."""
+
+    RETURN_TYPES = ("SGLD_OPTIONS",)
+    RETURN_NAMES = ("sgld_options",)
+    FUNCTION = "create_options"
+    CATEGORY = "SGLDiffusion"
+    DESCRIPTION = (
+        "Runtime options for the SGLD worker. Combinations the selected model "
+        "cannot run are rejected when the loader runs, before the worker starts."
+    )

+    @classmethod
+    def INPUT_TYPES(cls):
+        return {"required": {}, "optional": _FIELDS}
+
+    def create_options(self, **values):
+        # ComfyUI has already checked each value against INPUT_TYPES.
+        v = {name: spec[1]["default"] for name, spec in _FIELDS.items()} | values
+        execution = v["execution_mode"]
+        options = {
+            "num_gpus": v["num_gpus"],
+            "enable_torch_compile": execution == "torch_compile",
+            "regional_compile": execution == "torch_compile" and v["regional_compile"],
+            "enable_breakable_cuda_graph": execution == "cuda_graph",
+            "dit_layerwise_offload": v["memory_mode"] == "layerwise_offload",
+            "int8_kernel": _INT8_GEMMS[v["int8_gemm"]],
+            "cache_mode": v["cache_mode"],
+        }
+        if v["model_type"] != "auto-detect":

+        if v["parallel_mode"] == "manual":
+            options.update(_manual_layout(v))
+        if options["dit_layerwise_offload"]:

+            options["dit_offload_prefetch_size"] = v["prefetch_layers"]
+        backend = v["attention_backend"]
+        if backend != "auto":
+            options["attention_backend"] = _ATTENTION_IDS.get(backend, backend)
+        if v["attention_backend_config"].strip():
+            options["attention_backend_config"] = v["attention_backend_config"].strip()
+        if v["quantization"] != "none":
+            options["quantization"] = v["quantization"]
+        if v["cache_mode"] == "cache_dit" and v["cache_dit_tuning"] == "manual":
+            options["cache_dit_params"] = {
+                "max_warmup_steps": v["cache_warmup_steps"],
+                "residual_diff_threshold": v["cache_threshold"],
+                "max_continuous_cached_steps": v["cache_max_cached_steps"],
+                "Fn_compute_blocks": v["cache_fn_blocks"],
+            }
+        return (options,)
+
+
+def _manual_layout(v: dict) -> dict:
+    tp, ulysses, ring = v["tp_size"], v["ulysses_degree"], v["ring_degree"]
+    if tp * ulysses * ring != v["num_gpus"]:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"num_gpus ({v['num_gpus']}) must equal tp_size * ulysses_degree * "
+            f"ring_degree ({tp * ulysses * ring})"
+        )
+    return {
+        "tp_size": tp,
+        "sp_degree": ulysses * ring,
+        "ulysses_degree": ulysses,
+        "ring_degree": ring,
+    }

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""SGLDOptions output, model-aware preflight, and request wiring."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import Mock
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.apps.ComfyUI_SGLDiffusion.core.generator import (
+    SGLDiffusionGenerator,
+    _apply_cache_mode,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.apps.ComfyUI_SGLDiffusion.core.preflight import (
+    check_model_options,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.apps.ComfyUI_SGLDiffusion.options import SGLDOptions
+
+
+def _options(**values) -> dict:
+    return SGLDOptions().create_options(**values)[0]
+
+
+def test_cache_mode_reaches_the_h3_request() -> None:
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.apps.ComfyUI_SGLDiffusion.executors.minimax_h3 import (
+        MiniMaxH3Executor,
+    )
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.cache.cache_dit_integration import (
+        resolve_cache_dit_request_overrides,
+    )
+
+    assert "cache_dit_params" not in _options(cache_mode="cache_dit")
+    options = _options(cache_mode="cache_dit", cache_dit_tuning="manual")
+    assert resolve_cache_dit_request_overrides(options["cache_dit_params"])
+
+    executor = object.__new__(MiniMaxH3Executor)
+    torch.nn.Module.__init__(executor)
+    packed = SimpleNamespace(guidance_scale=1.0, height=512, width=512)
+    for values, cache_dit, spectrum in (
+        ({"cache_mode": "cache_dit", "cache_dit_tuning": "manual"}, True, False),
+        ({"cache_mode": "spectrum"}, False, True),
+    ):
+        _apply_cache_mode(executor, _options(**values))
+        request = executor._sampling_params_kwargs(packed, torch.tensor(1.0))
+        assert request["enable_cache_dit"] is cache_dit
+        assert request.get("enable_spectrum", False) is spectrum
+        assert ("cache_dit_params" in request) is cache_dit
+
+
+def test_manual_layout_derives_sp_and_checks_gpu_count() -> None:
+    options = _options(num_gpus=4, parallel_mode="manual", tp_size=2, ulysses_degree=2)
+    assert (options["tp_size"], options["sp_degree"]) == (2, 2)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="must equal"):
+        _options(num_gpus=2, parallel_mode="manual")
+
+
+_RING2 = {"num_gpus": 2, "parallel_mode": "manual", "ring_degree": 2}
+_GRAPH = {"execution_mode": "cuda_graph"}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "model_type, values, native_dir, message",
+    [
+        ("flux", _GRAPH, False, "cuda_graph is not"),
+        ("minimax_h3", {**_GRAPH, "cache_mode": "spectrum"}, False, "cache_mode=off"),
+        (
+            "minimax_h3",
+            {**_GRAPH, "memory_mode": "layerwise_offload"},
+            False,
+            "offload",
+        ),
+        ("fast_h3", {"execution_mode": "torch_compile"}, True, "eager"),
+        ("vdn_h3", _RING2, True, "ring_degree=1"),
+        (
+            "minimax_h3",
+            {**_RING2, "attention_backend": "sage_attention2"},
+            False,
+            "=fa",
+        ),
+        ("vdn_h3", {"attention_backend": "flash_attention"}, True, "does not apply"),
+        ("qwen_image", {"attention_backend": "sol_attention"}, False, "does not apply"),
+        ("flux", {"quantization": "fp8"}, False, "native model directories"),
+        ("lumina2", {"int8_gemm": "comfy_kitchen"}, False, "no effect"),
+        ("qwen_image", {"cache_mode": "cache_dit"}, False, "cache_dit is not"),
+        ("minimax_h3", {"cache_mode": "teacache"}, False, "teacache is not"),
+        ("minimax_h3", {"num_gpus": 2, "cache_mode": "spectrum"}, False, "degree 1"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_preflight_rejects_what_the_model_cannot_run(
+    model_type, values, native_dir, message
+) -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=message):
+        check_model_options(model_type, _options(**values), native_dir=native_dir)

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(

+    ],
+)
+def test_preflight_accepts_supported_combinations(

+) -> None:

+        )

+def test_rejected_options_keep_the_running_worker() -> None:
+    """A config error used to surface only after the previous worker was killed."""
+    runtime = SGLDiffusionGenerator()
+    runtime.get_comfyui_model = lambda *a: (SimpleNamespace(), None, "flux")
+    runtime.close_generator = Mock()
+    runtime.init_generator = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError("worker must not start"))
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="cuda_graph is not supported"):
+        runtime.load_model("flux.safetensors", sgld_options=_options(**_GRAPH))
+    runtime.close_generator.assert_not_called()
